scope: real PS Vita hardware startup of private full-engine build 00.04-installfix
result: vitaGL initialized successfully, then selector crashed in legacy immediate-mode vertex submission
screen_observed: vitaGL splash/logo appeared, then crash before the data-profile selector became visible

root_cause.details: The Vita runtime initializes vitaGL with legacy_pool_size=0 because the original Android renderer is GLES/client-array based. The custom boot selector still used glBegin/glVertex3f immediate mode. glVertex3f therefore dereferenced vitaGL's null legacy vertex pointer and generated a data abort at address zero.
root_cause.do_not_repeat: Do not use vitaGL GL1 immediate-mode glBegin/glVertex calls while the legacy pool is disabled.

fix.strategy: Keep the legacy pool at zero and convert selector/preview quads to GLES-style client vertex/texcoord arrays with glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLE_FAN).
